split_documents_train_valid: split a large text file into train and valid sets while respecting document boundaries separated by empty lines
split_lines_train_valid: split a text file into train and valid sets by individual lines using the --lines flag
reservoir_sampling_docs: use reservoir sampling to randomly select k documents from a large file for validation
run_split_script: run the script with an input file, train output, valid output, and -k to specify sample size
review_split_logic: review the reservoir sampling logic that maintains a fixed-size sample while processing documents sequentially
